t: When you are advising others and not doing it
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūn, kabura maqtan ʿinda-llāhi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūn.
m: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do? Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
